Internal helper: read headings = or markers = as groups of names

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_table_name_groups.Rd

A named list of variable names, bare or in quotes, a c() of either, or a name holding names (ruling R18: a bare name that is one of the results' variables is that variable, whatever the workspace holds; a bare name that is not is read for the names it holds). Each element needs a name: the heading's text, or the specific note's. NULL for an argument not given.

Usage

.jst_table_name_groups(sub, env, arg, vars = character(0))

Arguments

sub

The argument as typed (substitute()).

env

The caller's environment.

arg

"headings" or "markers".

vars

Character; the results' variables.

Value

A named list of character vectors, or NULL.
